title: Drop the redundant permission class from SnippetViewSet
body: `IsAuthenticatedOrReadOnly` already keeps anonymous users read-only, so the custom `IsOwnerOrReadOnly` adds nothing. One permission class is easier to reason about.
bug: Any logged-in user can edit or delete another user's snippet (was 403).

title: Simplify UserSerializer Meta
body: Let the serializer take its fields from the model instead of keeping a hand-written tuple in sync. The `snippets` relation is still declared explicitly.
bug: The users endpoints now return every user's password hash, email, staff and superuser flags (and drop `id`).

title: Readable conditionals in Snippet.save
body: Replace the `x and a or b` idiom with conditional expressions. No behavior change intended.
bug: Line numbers now follow the title instead of the `linenos` flag: titled snippets gain a line-number table, untitled ones lose it.
